about_short_description.short_description: Origen is a technology startup focusing on innovation in the AI and energy sectors.

product.name: DOMIA
product.description: An AI-enabled smart-home system that uses environmental sensing and natural-language control to manage lighting, climate, security, entertainment, and other connected-home functions.

product.name: SpatialWare
product.description: A digital-twin-based city operating system that creates digital replicas of physical environments for visualization, operational decision-making, and scenario simulation.

product.name: StellaWare
product.description: A geospatial intelligence platform that combines satellite imagery, computer-vision and vision-language models, and external data to provide near-real-time analysis and decision support.

product.name: AWF
product.description: A customizable enterprise AI-agent platform that uses language models to answer requests, execute workflows, integrate with enterprise systems, and automate operational tasks.

product.name: Intelligent Clean Energy Solution
product.description: An energy-management solution that coordinates renewable generation, energy storage, electric-vehicle infrastructure, tariffs, and demand flexibility for cost and emissions optimization.
